narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>Thirty six choices in five slots means thirty six times five, which is one hundred eighty.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Try two slots first. Each first choice pairs with thirty six second choices.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That gives thirty six times thirty six, far more than seventy two, so the slip fails.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 36 × 5 = 180; a tree grows from one first choice into 36 branches; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, think of a code of two characters first.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Thirty six rows of thirty six codes should give the same count as thirty six squared.
removed_beats.on_screen: the check line two slots first appears; the check line 36 rows of 36 appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says thirty six choices in five slots means thirty six times five. With two slots each first choice pairs with thirty six second choices, so the count multiplies.
